summary: Sensitivity of the leading eigenvalue of the Re = 100 cylinder wake to a steady force, solved by GMRES on the adjoint time stepper.
description: Regression values of this repository (not literature values): the sensitivity field of the Re = 100 cylinder to a steady force (mode 4.41). The magnitude is concentrated in the recirculation bubble and in the shear layers next to the cylinder, and is close to zero upstream and beyond x = 7. The GMRES solve must end below its target of 1e-6 in the squared residual; before the correction of the boundary conditions in the case file it stalled at 1e-2. The velocity norms of the converged field agree to 3e-4 between T = 1 and T = 2.

gmres_squared_residual.note: Convergence gate: passes for any final squared residual from 0 to 1e-6, the GMRES target.

sensitivity_vx_xpeak.note: Streamwise position of the largest |vx|, in cylinder diameters from the cylinder centre.
